title: Derived limit comparison for the prescribed section models
statement: Let $A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category with inverse limits of natural-number towers, additive inverse-limit functor, and K-injective resolutions of towers. Fix derived-category models [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $F:A\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be additive and preserve these inverse limits. Write $T$ for termwise application of $F$ to towers. There is a natural isomorphism $RF\circ R\!\lim_A\cong R\!\lim_{\mathrm{Ab}}\circ RT$. Use the standard derived categories for abelian groups and their towers, with their additive inverse-limit functor, as in [lem-coef-sequence-sections-limit-comparison].

source.place: Tags 079P, 0941 and 0D6E; the normalized coefficient sections construction.

proof.text: Inverse limit preserves K-injective complexes: its left adjoint is the exact constant-diagram functor. The completed composite unit for inverse limit followed by F is therefore invertible on K-injectives and makes the composite a right derivation.

The proved tower-image acyclicity lemma makes derived abelian inverse limit after derived termwise F a right derivation of the other ordinary composite. Preservation of limits by F identifies the ordinary composites. Apply the universal right-derived natural isomorphism to their composite units.
